findings: P2 — src/player.ts:101,130-137: Guard app-originated initial result notifications after the request promise finishes. activeCountryRequest is cleared in finally, after which any kind=initial notification is accepted unconditionally. A delayed/duplicate host notification from an older picker request can overwrite the newer country and call player.clearSelection, stopping newer playback. Delivered-bundle probe shows US playing becoming GB idle with source removed. Promise serial checks do not protect this route. Distinguish/correlate picker completions from fresh chat-originated results, and test late and duplicate notifications after the latest picker promise has settled, including same-country results.

P2 — src/player.ts:87-101,128: Restore usable controls on country-request failure. Starting a country request clears pending but never refreshes controls; if an old Retry was in flight, its button is disabled and its finally no longer matches pending. When the new country request fails or returns malformed data, no acceptInitial/refreshControls occurs, leaving Retry disabled indefinitely despite a retained partial catalog. The selector also remains on the failed country while old-country choices remain, so the instruction to choose the same country again does not trigger a native change event. Reconcile selector and retained catalog, offer a real retry path, and refresh controls on cancellation/failure; add a delayed Retry plus failed picker regression.

spec_acceptance.criterion: The 16-country picker and country tool expose the researched countries, with exact-country MP3 results only. The 16 candidate UUID/URL pairs are admitted only while their current provider rows still match the fixed policy. For each country, fresh evidence records directory presence, exclusion, count, and any drift; missing pairs are explicit gaps.
spec_acceptance.evidence: All 16 scans completed; the 15 active candidate tuples remain exact and admitted, and the Sweden picker still works. SE had zero compatible results after three successful windows. The former SE UUID/URL is not in the active registry, matchesCountryCandidate is false, parseMediaUrl rejects it, and its origin is absent from MEDIA_ORIGINS. The explicit gap/no-substitution status is documented in docs/DIAL-009-CANDIDATE-STATUS.md.
spec_acceptance.method: Freshly scanned all 16 countries and inspected the exact active registry/parser/CSP policy and Sweden picker.

spec_acceptance.criterion: A fresh independent direct probe for each admitted pair records status, content type, redirect behavior and capped MP3 bytes. A direct probe is not called ChatGPT playback. Changes to any URL/origin require new spec approval, not an automatic substitution.
spec_acceptance.evidence: All fifteen remaining UUIDs and exact URLs are unchanged from the prior Verify at 2026-11-12T07:52Z. Each prior no-redirect GET read at most 256 bytes and returned 200/206, audio/mpeg, 256 bytes, with MPEG frame sync. Those dated direct observations are carried forward, not represented as a new check. The SE URL was not retried. Direct bytes still do not establish host playback.
spec_acceptance.method: Verified the fifteen remaining registry tuples/URLs are byte-for-byte equal to the prior Verify’s admitted tuples and checked each prior capped direct result; preserved the original timestamp and result for each.

spec_acceptance.criterion: Country scans preserve the DIAL-008 limits, 8-item local reveal, known-choice More, partial/manual Retry, stale-result guards, safe text, selection/audio continuity, exact CSP, signed click reporting and its disclosure.

Focused tests confirm DIAL-008 bounds/reveal/retry/stale guards, all fifteen exact tuples, SE exclusion and no-SE-origin CSP, and playback coordination. This commit only removes SE tuple and adds truthful evidence/tests/docs; no other media origin or policy was broadened.
spec_acceptance.method: Ran full suite on exact candidate and inspected latest accepted Review and commit diff.

spec_acceptance.criterion: NTS 1 and NTS 2 are plainly discoverable as NTS editorial channels with the official link and no country claim. In-player controls are enabled only after the narrow compatibility gate passes. Otherwise both official links and an honest unavailable state work. NTS plays never report a Radio Browser click.

spec_acceptance.method: Inspected NTS markup/player implementation and full UI harness tests.

spec_acceptance.criterion: The player is compact, keyboard accessible, usable at narrow and desktop widths in light/dark host themes, and has clear Play/Pause and failure states. Independent Review and Verify bind to the exact candidate commit. Verify records catalog admission, direct reachability, CSP, and actual ChatGPT audio separately; absent host playback or layout evidence is BLOCKED, never inferred from unit tests.
